component.name: Infiniminer
component.summary: Team-based block mining and building game

description.p: Two teams race to dig gold and diamonds out of a world of blocks and bring them back to the surface. Prospectors find treasure, miners dig fast, engineers build, and sappers blow things up.

This is a cross-platform port of the original 2009 game by Zach Barth (Zachtronics), with a server browser, hosting a game from the menu, computer players, controller and Steam Deck support, and spectating.
